state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done.** Every `Core` class carries its card, and
`rule:tooling/the-index-names-every-key-command-and-code` is shipped: `nvs agent index` ends with a
`config:`, `command:`, `flag:` and `code:` line per key, command, flag and diagnostic code, derived
in `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent/names.rs` (its module doc says from which table, and what the symbol
of such a line is). The guard `every_key_command_flag_and_code_is_an_index_entry` is a unit test in
that file, not in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs`: the crate is a binary only, so only a unit test
reaches `crate::Cli::command()`. `code::ALL` in `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` is written by
the `codes!` macro that wraps the `code` module, so no list is kept by hand.

A code's line is `code: E0621` alone and its `show` card is that line alone: the first sentence of
its card joins the line in Stage 4. Stage 5 (`bun nv proofs` owes help) is not started.

next.title: every diagnostic code carries its card

items.text: **The card field** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; give the `codes!` macro at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:48` a card per code (a `card` beside each `Code::new`, the macro matching it), and list every code without one in `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, with `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` holding the two together as the class-card test does. `code::ALL` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:68` is where the list is derived.

**`show <code>` prints the card, and the line carries its first sentence** — `rule:tooling/the-index-names-every-key-command-and-code`; `codes()` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent/names.rs:148` sets `Entry::body` to the card and appends the first sentence to the line.
**The terminal rendering names `nvs agent show <code>` once** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the closing summary in `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/render.rs:276`.
**Drain the list, one band per session, in file order** — `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:48`; cards are written for the person who met the error (goal § *Standing decisions*).

backlog: Stage 5: `bun nv proofs` owes Help for the whole roster, and `data/proofs/help-backlog.json` drains to empty — goal prose § *Stage 5*.

`[db.main]`, `[mail.default]` and `[storage.local]` keys are indexed under the file's example name, not `<name>`; `tools/nv/cmd/directives.ts` knows which segments are names — `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent/names.rs`.
